about.title: Fontana Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Twenty-one people died in traffic collisions in Fontana during 2025, out of 799 injury crashes recorded across the city. Behind each of those numbers is a household in San Bernardino County that suddenly has to plan a funeral, pay bills without a paycheck, and figure out what comes next. A wrongful death claim exists for that gap. It is a civil action, separate from any criminal charges, and it belongs to the family rather than the state. Under California law, a surviving spouse or domestic partner and children hold the first right to bring the claim; certain dependents and heirs may qualify when there is no spouse or child. Recoverable losses reach beyond funeral and burial costs to the financial support the person would have provided and the love, companionship and guidance that cannot be replaced. Collision reports in Fontana cluster along Sierra Avenue, the I-10, Citrus Avenue and Foothill Boulevard. LawProactive is not a law firm. We connect you, for free, with an independent attorney who handles these cases on contingency, so there is no fee unless there is a recovery.

whyChoose.title: Why Fontana Families Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Clarity on who can file
items.desc: California limits standing to a spouse or domestic partner and children first, then certain dependents and heirs. The attorney you're connected with can sort out where your family fits before anyone files anything.

items.title: A deadline you won't miss
items.desc: The general limit is two years from the date of death, but it is shorter when a city, county or state agency may share fault. Getting connected early keeps every option open.

items.title: The full picture of what was lost
items.desc: Recoverable losses include funeral and burial costs, the income and support your loved one would have provided, and the loss of love, companionship and guidance. An independent attorney can account for all of it, on contingency.

items.question: The crash happened on the I-10 in Fontana. Does that change the deadline?
items.answer: It might. If a government entity such as Caltrans, San Bernardino County or the City of Fontana could be partly responsible for a road condition, California requires a formal claim to be filed with that agency well before the standard two-year wrongful death deadline. Because those windows are short, it's worth having an attorney review the facts soon after the loss.

items.question: The other driver is facing criminal charges. Do we have to wait for that case?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a civil action brought by the family and is separate from any criminal prosecution handled by the San Bernardino County District Attorney. The two cases can move at the same time, and the outcome of one does not decide the other, though evidence from the criminal case can sometimes be useful.

items.question: My parent died and there is no surviving spouse. Can adult children bring the claim?
items.answer: Yes. Under California law, children have standing alongside a spouse or domestic partner, and when there is no spouse, the children hold the first right to file. If there are no surviving children either, certain dependents and heirs may qualify, and an independent attorney can confirm who is eligible in your situation.
